text: So yeah, thanks for having me on the show. Why do most YouTube channels never get past a thousand subscribers? The biggest mistake is the first three seconds of every video. You have one sentence to tell people why they should stay. Here is the simple rule I use: say the payoff first, then explain. We tested it on 40 videos and retention went up 31 percent. And then we talked about thumbnails for a while. But honestly that part matters less than people think. Stop editing for ten hours if your opening line is weak. Fix the hook first and everything else gets easier for you.
